folders.name: repos
folders.text: Projects with their own git history and their own remote. They are cloned by bootstrap/restore.sh and are not part of the workspace repository.

folders.name: mcps
folders.role: runtime and rules of the MCP servers
folders.text: The servers that reach Paperless, Home Assistant and the two hosts over SSH, plus diary and GitHub. Only what belongs to this machine is here; the code lives in its project.

folders.name: skills
folders.text: Knowledge about a tool or a procedure, loaded on demand. The folder is not published as it is: several skills name this machine's services.

folders.name: configs
folders.role: this machine's rules for tools from repos/
folders.text: The concrete window layout, the real tile list. Not public: it is this machine's configuration, not the tool's capability.

folders.name: bootstrap
folders.role: how this machine is rebuilt from GitHub
folders.text: restore.sh clones the projects, repos.txt is the only list of their names. Published.

folders.name: models
folders.text: GGUF files for the local llama.cpp server. Not versioned, not published, and no agent names them any more.

folders.name: secrets
folders.text: Closed to the agent by configuration. Only its existence is named here, never its content — not even the file names.

folders.name: backups
folders.text: Closed to the agent by configuration. Existence only, for the same reason as secrets/.

folders.name: scratch
folders.text: What lies here is deleted, not maintained. The folder may be absent.

files.name: AGENTS.md
files.text: The rules of this workspace: structure, boundaries, the standard.

files.name: contract.md
files.text: The pointer to the public standard and the local exceptions.

files.name: opencode.json
files.text: MCP servers, skills path, permissions and the model policy. No secrets.

repos.name: app-template
repos.description: The vanilla static starter with Lorem Ipsum, tests and a green check.

repos.name: basic-apps
repos.description: This page: the public state of the workspace, generated from the folder tree.

repos.name: basic-specs
repos.description: The versioned standard: rules, profiles, checker, specimen and the public registry.

repos.name: diary
repos.description: Dated entries in SQLite, readable and searchable in the browser; an AI may only append.

repos.name: die-wand
repos.description: A wall of bookmark tiles, static, no account, no cloud.

repos.name: filmchen
repos.description: Turns a folder of numbered pictures, clips, narration and pauses into one MP4.

repos.name: four-wins
repos.description: Connect Four in Angular, live on GitHub Pages.

repos.name: mycents
repos.description: A local-first personal finance ledger for accounts, neutral transfers, recurring routines and yearly comparison.

repos.name: startup-layout
repos.description: A GNOME Shell extension that builds the window layout at login.
